name: windows
description: Virtual kit: Windows sysadmin tools grouped under a shared prefix. Alias FQCNs like 'dazzletools:windows:sicacls' resolve to canonical dazzletools tools without moving files. Gives Windows-focused utilities (ACL/permission fixers, diagnostics export redaction) a clear home separate from the general cross-platform dazzletools utilities (redact-msinfo itself is cross-platform -- the input is a Windows artifact). 'safe-icacls' is also reachable by its short alias 'sicacls'; 'fixuser' (alias 'fixusr') diagnoses and repairs broken or temporary user profiles.
